# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before working on any task in this repository, read all LLM context files located in:

```
ckanext-hdx_theme/llm_docs/
```

These files contain essential context about the project's architecture, design system, templates, CSS/JS conventions, and other domain knowledge required to contribute correctly.

## Current context files

- [`ckanext-hdx_theme/llm_docs/LLM_CONTEXT_HDX_DESIGN.md`](../ckanext-hdx_theme/llm_docs/LLM_CONTEXT_HDX_DESIGN.md) — HTML/CSS/JS design context: template roots, BEM components, asset bundles, and webassets configuration.

## How to use

1. Read every file in `ckanext-hdx_theme/llm_docs/` at the start of each session.
2. Apply the conventions described there when generating or modifying code.
3. When new architectural decisions are made, update the relevant file in `ckanext-hdx_theme/llm_docs/` so the context stays accurate.
